summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted for an allogeneic stem cell transplant from her matched sister following complete remission from CML in myeloblastic crisis. She underwent myeloablative conditioning with fludarabine and busulfan, followed by stem cell infusion on day 6. The hospital course was complicated by neutropenic fever, nausea, vomiting, mucositis, headaches, and a presyncopal episode due to dehydration. She required IV hydration and antiemetic adjustments. Multiple central lines were placed and repositioned as needed. No infections were identified on repeated cultures. Engraftment occurred by day +15, with improving counts and resolution of symptoms. Discharge was delayed due to persistent nausea but was achieved on day +23 with plans for home IV support and close outpatient follow-up.
